text.23:101: And when the trumpet is blown there will be no kinship among them that day, nor will they ask of one another.
text.25:54: And He it is Who hath created man from water, and hath appointed for him kindred by blood and kindred by marriage; for thy Lord is ever Powerful.
text.37:158: And they imagine kinship between him and the jinn, whereas the jinn know well that they will be brought before (Him).
